categories.main_business_segments: Eternal Precision Mechanics Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the manufacturing and sales of precision machinery equipment, focusing on vacuum lamination machines used in semiconductor packaging and electronic component manufacturing. The company also operates in mechanical installation, electronic components manufacturing, optical instruments, plastic films and bags wholesale and retail, international trade, and consulting services. Its core products serve the IC substrate and advanced packaging equipment markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in vacuum lamination technology with high precision thermal press control, vacuum environment control, and integrated thin film handling systems. It develops customized vacuum lamination machines for ABF substrates and advanced semiconductor packaging, employing modular design, precise temperature and pressure control, and automation. The production process includes design, prototyping, precision parts manufacturing, assembly, calibration, testing, and quality inspection, with key components sourced from Japanese and Taiwanese suppliers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major IC substrate manufacturers and semiconductor packaging companies, including global leaders in ABF substrate production. The end markets served include semiconductor, PCB, FPC, LED, and advanced electronic device manufacturing sectors. The company’s products are critical in high-performance computing, AI servers, data centers, 5G/6G communications, automotive electronics, and other advanced packaging applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan, Japan, China (Guangzhou), and has offices and factories in these regions. Its sales are concentrated in Asia, with growing markets in Europe and the Americas. The company actively expands its presence in emerging markets such as Southeast Asia and China to capture local demand and provide timely support.
categories.supply_chain_position: Eternal Precision Mechanics operates upstream in the semiconductor supply chain as a supplier of advanced manufacturing equipment, specifically vacuum lamination machines used in IC substrate and semiconductor packaging production. It supplies critical production equipment to substrate manufacturers and packaging service providers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in vacuum lamination technology, automation, and precision control to meet evolving semiconductor packaging demands. It focuses on developing next-generation glass substrate lamination, wafer-level vacuum lamination, and automated handling equipment. Strategic initiatives include collaboration with Japanese subsidiaries, integration of AI for process optimization, and expansion into new advanced packaging applications to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through customized equipment sales, including vacuum lamination machines and related automation systems. The company also derives income from after-sales services, maintenance contracts, and technical support. Its business model emphasizes long-term customer relationships and continuous equipment upgrades.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Japanese PCB equipment manufacturers such as Meiki, Qunyi, and Zhisheng, though these competitors are less specialized in ABF vacuum lamination machines. Eternal Precision Mechanics holds a leading global market position with a dominant share exceeding 95% in the IC substrate vacuum lamination equipment segment, supported by superior yield rates, integrated design, and strong customer service.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$2.23 billion in the latest fiscal year, with a net profit of around NT$299 million. It maintains a stable financial structure with a debt-to-asset ratio below 50% and a return on equity exceeding 19%. Despite recent market fluctuations, the company sustains steady profitability and is positioned for growth driven by expanding demand in AI and high-performance computing sectors.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Eternal Precision Mechanics differentiates itself through industry-leading high yield and flatness vacuum lamination technology, proprietary thin film handling integration, and a unique combination of Japanese precision manufacturing with global professional service teams. Its deep industry experience, customized solutions, and continuous innovation create high switching costs for customers and ensure superior product quality and reliability, making it the preferred partner for advanced semiconductor packaging equipment.
